pages.text: The Nether has its races too: three bases near the place under your spawn, each in a great hall carved into the rock with its hero in it — $(l)Zagara$()'s lair, $(l)Tosh$()'s base and $(l)Zeratul$()'s — and, far rarer than above, mineral halls with their geysers. Tosh cloaks a while in a fight, Zeratul is cloaked and shows only now and then (a detector sees them always); Zagara throws banelings, calls hydralisks and digs under the ground to come up behind you.

Beaten, each is freed with its base, like the overworld's heroes, and gives the Nether's part of the artifact's key of its race. In the fight against Amun they bring more troops: ghosts, dark templar, banelings and hydralisks.
